text:
IncidentBot: PAGER: SEV=1 025 customer: atlas-enterprises (dedicated-pool-21, VPC). Tenant-eval alert: regression detected after quant profile kq-int4-fast rollout; extraction and multi-field parsing quality dropped ~28% vs baseline. Please acknowledge and triage.

Marta (oncall): Ack. I'm grabbing the bridge. @Ivan CS please confirm impact from support side.

Ivan CS: On call with customer now. They have multiple ETL jobs failing entity mapping and address parsing. Started ~2025-06-03T03:14Z. Only atlas-enterprises affected. They're flagging this as "high business impact" because downstream billing jobs rely on parsed fields.

Marta (oncall): Thanks. Quick facts: which quant profile was applied to pool-21 and which model variant? @Ruchi Infra any config pushes?

Ruchi Infra: Looking at config logs: 2025-06-03T03:02:11Z - applied profile kq-int4-fast to model redwood-parse-3 on dedicated-pool-21. Author: theo.ml. No infra changes in same window.

Theo ML: I promoted kq-int4-fast after microbenchmarks for latency. We ran generic evals but missed atlas-enterprises custom eval set. If it's causing regressions, we can revert immediately.

Marta (oncall): Triage plan: 1) Immediate tenant-scoped revert quant profile to kq-int8-stable for atlas-enterprises on pool-21. 2) If revert doesn't reach all serving nodes in 5m, failover atlas-enterprises traffic to fallback pool-5 (variant redwood-parse-3-v2). 3) Keep customer on bridge and provide updates every 10m. 4) Capture artifacts for postmortem.

Marta (oncall): Executing revert now:

```
infractl tenant-revert-quant --tenant atlas-enterprises --pool dedicated-pool-21 --model redwood-parse-3 --from kq-int4-fast --to kq-int8-stable --initiator marta_oncall
```

DeployBot: Job queued (job-id=job-625-20250603). Applying tenant-config revert.

DeployBot: Revert applied to control plane. Propagation to serving fleet in progress. 50% nodes updated.

Marta (oncall): Sampling production traffic. Initial samples still show malformed address lines but quality improving on reverted nodes.

QA-Bot: Running atlas-enterprises golden set against post-revert cluster. Preliminary: 88/100 pass, prior to revert was 54/100.

Ivan CS: Customer confirms some pipelines recovered, but asks to pin them to stable profile and wants an RCA. They need docs for compliance.

Marta (oncall): Ok pin action:

```
infractl pin-profile --tenant atlas-enterprises --model redwood-parse-3 --profile kq-int8-stable --duration 72h --reason "post-quant-revert stabilization"
```

DeployBot: Pin applied for 72h.

Theo ML: I'll add atlas-enterprises evals to the quantation preflight and pause further kq-int4-fast promotions until we have tenant-aware canaries. Also will revert the pool-wide flag until gating exists.

Ruchi Infra: I'll add a quick guardrail to config-service: reject pool-scoped quant updates when any tenant has explicit per-tenant evals flagged as required. Hotfix queued.

Marta (oncall): Capturing timeline for incident ticket: rollout 2025-06-03T03:02:11Z, alert 03:14:07Z, revert start 03:17:30Z, revert effective across nodes 03:19:48Z, pin 03:25:00Z. Blast radius: one tenant (atlas-enterprises) on dedicated-pool-21. Impact: parsing/extraction regressions causing downstream ETL failures and potential billing mismatches.

Ivan CS: Customer asked for a temporary mitigation: maintain duplicate routing to both stable and fast profiles with shadow logging for 48h so they can validate internally before we reattempt any fast profile. They want the option to opt-in to fast profile later.

Marta (oncall): We can enable shadow route for 48h. Command:

```
infractl add-shadow-route --tenant atlas-enterprises --model redwood-parse-3 --primary-profile kq-int8-stable --shadow-profile kq-int4-fast --duration 48h --log-samples true
```

DeployBot: Shadow routing enabled. Logs will be stored to s3://incidents/atlas-enterprises/shadow/20250603. Sampling rate: 1000 reqs/min.

Theo ML: I'll review shadow diffs and add failing examples to the quant CI harness. Planning to implement a tenant-canary step: select 1-2 tenants per pool (with consent) for 24h validation before pool-wide apply.

Ruchi Infra: Config-service patch will require explicit --force flag for pool-scoped quant changes and will surface tenant-eval missing warnings. Rolling hotfix in 30m.

Marta (oncall): Assign follow-ups: Theo -> CI diffs and tenant-canary PR (owner: theo). Ruchi -> config-service guardrails hotfix (owner: ruchi). Ivan -> customer comms and approval for shadow-routing (owner: ivan). Marta -> create incident ticket and draft preliminary RCA; handoff to next oncall.

Ivan CS: Customer appreciates prompt response. They're asking for a preliminary RCA within 8h.

Marta (oncall): Handoff: Next oncall is Omar in 4h. Omar please monitor shadow logs and metrics; if any regression reappears, escalate.

Omar (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll monitor and kick off postmortem if needed.

Marta (oncall): Closing live thread: mitigation in place, customer stabilized, shadowing enabled for additional verification. Reopen if metrics worsen.

IncidentBot: Thread closed by marta_oncall.

Note: artifacts and logs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2359876543/artifacts (samples, qa-diffs, config-diffs).
